DA_InvestmentStrategyI.text: Your champions gain 8 permanent max health per interest you earn. Gain 3 gold now.

DA_CaretakersFavor.name: Caretaker's Favor
DA_CaretakersFavor.text:
Gain a component anvil when you reach level 5, 6, 7, and 8.

Component anvils offer 4 choices.

DA_YoungAndWildAndFree.name: Young and Wild and Free
DA_YoungAndWildAndFree.text: You can always move freely on Carousel rounds. Gain 5 gold.

DA_BeltOverflow.name: Belt Overflow
DA_BeltOverflow.text: Gain 4 Giant's Belts. Your Giant's Belts grant +85 bonus Health.

DA_PrismaticTicket.name: Prismatic Ticket
DA_PrismaticTicket.text: Each time your shop is rerolled you have a 45% chance to gain a free reroll.

DA_PatienceIsAVirtue.name: Patience Is A Virtue
DA_PatienceIsAVirtue.text: Gain 5 rerolls now. Each round, gain 1 free reroll if you did not buy a champion last round.

DA_LivingForge.name: Living Forge
DA_LivingForge.text: Gain an Artifact Anvil now and after every 10 player combats.

DA_Epoch.name: Epoch
DA_Epoch.text: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 4 XP and 2 free rerolls.

DA_EpochPlus.name: Epoch+
DA_EpochPlus.text: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 8 XP and 2 free rerolls.

DA_WandOverflow.name: Wand Overflow
DA_WandOverflow.text: Gain 4 Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +5% Attack Speed.

DA_Kingslayer.name: Kingslayer
DA_Kingslayer.text: After winning player combat, gain 1 gold. If they had more health than you, gain 6 Gold instead. Gain 1 gold.

DA_CookingPot.name: Cooking Pot
DA_CookingPot.text: At the start of each round, all allies holding a Frying Pan or Spatula item grant the nearest champion 70 permanent Health. Gain a Frying Pan.

DA_RadiantRelic.name: Radiant Relics
DA_RadiantRelic.text: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

DA_HardBargain.name: Hard Bargain
DA_HardBargain.text:
You cannot choose your Carousel rewards. Gain an additional 6 player health and 8 gold each carousel round.
When you do not pick a Carousel Reward, you are given an unpicked champion and the item it carries.

DA_Min_Max.name: Min-Max
DA_Min_Max.text: Gain a Golden Item Remover, 4 random components, and 4 gold.

DA_FocusedFire.name: Focused Fire
DA_FocusedFire.text: Your team gains 10% Attack Damage. Every 5 seconds, they gain 4% more.

DA_ExtraBuckles.name: Extra Buckles
DA_ExtraBuckles.text: Gain a Giant's Belt. After your champions take 75000 damage, get 2 more.

DA_MakeshiftArmorI.name: Makeshift Armor
DA_MakeshiftArmorI.text: Champions without items equipped gain 30 Armor and Magic Resist.

DA_MakeshiftArmorII.name: Makeshift Armor II
DA_MakeshiftArmorII.text: Champions without items equipped gain 50 Armor and Magic Resist.

DA_CryMeARiver.name: Cry Me A River
DA_CryMeARiver.text: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. Your team gains 1 Mana Regen. After 12 seconds in combat, increase this to 3.

DA_BandOfThievesII.name: Band of Thieves II
DA_BandOfThievesII.text: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

DA_BandOfThievesIIPlus.name: Band of Thieves II+
DA_BandOfThievesIIPlus.text: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

DA_BandOfThievesIIPlusPlus.name: Band of Thieves II++
DA_BandOfThievesIIPlusPlus.text: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 3 player combats, gain another.

DA_GroupHugI.name: Group Hug
DA_GroupHugI.text: Combat start: Allies grant other adjacent allies 7 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

DA_GroupHugII.name: Group Hug II
DA_GroupHugII.text: Combat start: Allies grant other adjacent allies 10 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

DA_BacklineBlueprint.name: Backline Blueprint
DA_BacklineBlueprint.text: Gain a 3-cost non-Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

DA_GoldenEgg.name: The Golden Egg
DA_GoldenEgg.text: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 rounds for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra round.

DA_TradeSectorPlus.name: Trade Sector+
DA_TradeSectorPlus.text: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 8 gold.

DA_BackupBows.name: Backup Bows
DA_BackupBows.text: Gain a Recurve Bow. After your champions attack 1000 times, get 2 more.

DA_CarveAPath.name: Carve a Path
DA_CarveAPath.text: Gain a B.F. Sword. After your champions deal 65000 physical damage, gain 2 more.

DA_LuckyGloves.name: Lucky Gloves
DA_LuckyGloves.text: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves and [gold?] gold.

DA_LuckyGlovesPlus.name: Lucky Gloves+
DA_LuckyGlovesPlus.text: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves now, then another after 4 player combats.

DA_MoneyHungry_NotBroken.name: Money Hungry
DA_MoneyHungry_NotBroken.text: Gain 7 gold now, then 7 gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

DA_MoneyHungryPlus.name: Money Hungry+
DA_MoneyHungryPlus.text: Gain 13 gold now, then 7 gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

DA_MoneyMonsoon.name: Money Monsoon
DA_MoneyMonsoon.text: Gain 7 gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

DA_Slammin.name: Slammin'
DA_Slammin.text: Gain 3 gold. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

DA_SlamminPlus.name: Slammin'+
DA_SlamminPlus.text: Gain 4 gold and 10 XP now. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

DA_CraftedCrafting.name: Crafted Crafting
DA_CraftedCrafting.text: Whenever you craft a completed item, gain 2 rerolls.

DA_PandorasItemsI.name: Pandora's Items
DA_PandorasItemsI.text:
Round start: items on your bench are randomized.

Gain 1 random component.

DA_PandorasItemsIIPlus.name: Pandora's Items II+
DA_PandorasItemsIIPlus.text:
Round start: items on your bench are randomized.

Gain 2 random components and 4 gold.

DA_PandorasItemsIII.name: Pandora's Items III
DA_PandorasItemsIII.text:
Round start: items on your bench are randomized.

Gain 1 Radiant item.

DA_SalvageBin.name: Salvage Bin
DA_SalvageBin.text: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 8 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

DA_SalvageBinPlus.name: Salvage Bin+
DA_SalvageBinPlus.text: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 4 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

DA_ClearMind.name: Clear Mind
DA_ClearMind.text: If there are no champions on your bench at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

DA_CelestialBlessingI.name: Celestial Blessing
DA_CelestialBlessingI.text: Your team gains 12% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 200 Health.

DA_CelestialBlessingII.name: Celestial Blessing II
DA_CelestialBlessingII.text: Your team gains 18% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 400 Health.

DA_CelestialBlessingIII.name: Celestial Blessing III
DA_CelestialBlessingIII.text: Your team gains 25% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 1000 Health.

DA_AdvancedLoan.name: Advanced Loan
DA_AdvancedLoan.text: Gain 22 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

DA_AdvancedLoanPlus.name: Advanced Loan+
DA_AdvancedLoanPlus.text: Gain 33 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

DA_Pilfer.name: Pilfer
DA_Pilfer.text: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain 21 gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves.

DA_TeamBuilding.name: Team Building
DA_TeamBuilding.text:
Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator. Gain another after 5 player combats.

This item allows you to copy a 3-cost or less champion.

DA_RadiantRascal.name: Radiant Rascal
DA_RadiantRascal.text: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

DA_HardCommit.name: Hard Commit
DA_HardCommit.text: Gain a random emblem. Now and at the start of each stage, gain a 1-star champion of that trait with a cost equal to the Stage (max 5) and 3 gold.

DA_LateGameSpecialist.name: Late Game Specialist
DA_LateGameSpecialist.text: When you reach Level 9, gain 27 gold.

DA_ForgeAFriend.name: Forge A Friend
DA_ForgeAFriend.text: The next 1-cost champion you buy is 3-star. Gain 5 gold.

DA_HoldTheLine.name: Hold the Line
DA_HoldTheLine.text: Allies in your back 2 rows gain 11% Ability Power and 11% Attack Damage for each ally that starts combat in your front row.

DA_FindYourCenter.name: Find Your Center
DA_FindYourCenter.text: Your champion that starts combat in the center of the front row gains 15% Damage Amp and 25% max Health.

DA_LegionOfThrees.name: Legion Of Threes
DA_LegionOfThrees.text:
Gain a random Emblem. Your 3-cost champions and all allies equipped with an Emblem gain 150 Health and 12% Attack Speed.

Reckoning Championship, 2021

DA_BirthdayReunion.name: Birthday Reunion
DA_BirthdayReunion.text:
Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion. At Level 6, gain a random item component. At Level 9, gain a random 2-star 5-cost champion.

Inkborn Fables Tactician's Crown, 2024

DA_TacticiansKitchen.name: Tactician's Kitchen
DA_TacticiansKitchen.text: Gain a random Emblem. After 3 rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

DA_Flexible.name: Flexible
DA_Flexible.text: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains 30 Health for each Emblem they are holding.

DA_EpicRolldown.name: Epic Rolldown
DA_EpicRolldown.text:
When you reach Level 8, gain 20 Shop rerolls.

Runeterra Reforged Championship, 2023

DA_LateGameScaling.name: Late Game Scaling
DA_LateGameScaling.text:
Gain 2 XP at the start of player combat rounds. Your 5-cost champions gain 12% Health and 12% Attack Speed.

Cyber City Tactician's Crown, 2025

DA_SoloPlate.name: Solo Plate
DA_SoloPlate.text: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain 17% max Health if they start combat alone in their row.

DA_TwinGuardians.name: Twin Guardians
DA_TwinGuardians.text: If you have exactly 2 allies in your first row, grant them 100 Health, 35 Armor, and 35 Magic Resist.

DA_PromisedProtection.name: Promised Protection
DA_PromisedProtection.text: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder 20% additional Mana from all sources and 175 max Health.

DA_CommerceCore.name: Commerce Core
DA_CommerceCore.text: Gain 16 free Shop rerolls now and 3 every round for the rest of the game.

DA_BodyguardTraining.name: Bodyguard Training
DA_BodyguardTraining.text:
Allies gain 15 Armor and Magic Resist, increased by 2 per player level.

Gizmos & Gadgets Championship, 2022

DA_SpeedyDoubleKill.name: Speedy Double Kill
DA_SpeedyDoubleKill.text:
Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When 2 players are eliminated, gain 40 gold.

Fates Championship, 2021

DA_ForgedInStrength.name: Forged In Strength
DA_ForgedInStrength.text:
Gain 1 random Artifact. When you drop below 35 Health, gain 1 more random Artifact, 1 random completed item, and 3 random components.

Remix Rumble Championship, 2023

DA_SoulAwakening.name: Soul Awakening
DA_SoulAwakening.text: Combat start: Your team gains 1.5% Attack Damage and Ability Power per second for 10 seconds. At max stacks, deal 12% bonus true damage.

DA_FlowingTears.name: Flowing Tears
DA_FlowingTears.text: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. After your champions spend 7000 Mana, gain 2 more.

DA_TheGoldenDragon.name: The Golden Dragon
DA_TheGoldenDragon.text:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up +1 team slot but gain 600 Health and 15% Durability.

Mogul's Mail gives gold as well as combat power.
Dragonlands Championship, 2022

DA_ShimmerscaleEssence.name: Shimmerscale Essence
DA_ShimmerscaleEssence.text: Gain a Gambler's Blade. After 6 player combats, gain a Mogul's Mail.

DA_SeraphimsStaff.name: Seraphim's Staff
DA_SeraphimsStaff.text: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants 2 additional Mana Regen if its holder has 110% or more Ability Power.

DA_ArcaneViktory.name: Arcane Viktor-y
DA_ArcaneViktory.text:
After 8 seconds of combat, stun the enemy team for 1.5 seconds. Repeat this after 18 seconds of combat.

TFT Macao Open, 2024

DA_GiantAndMighty.name: Giant and Mighty
DA_GiantAndMighty.text: Your team becomes large, gaining 225 Health and 10% max Health.

DA_WovenMagic.name: Woven Magic
DA_WovenMagic.text: Gain a random item component. Every 2200 Mana spent by your champions, grants an additional component (max: ⟨⟩/3).

DA_MaxBuild.name: Max Build
DA_MaxBuild.text:
Gain 10 free Shop rerolls. When you reach level 9, gain 3 free Shop rerolls and a Champion Duplicator.

Galaxies Championship, 2020

DA_Hustler.name: Hustler
DA_Hustler.text:
You no longer gain interest but gain 3 gold at the start of every player combat round. Gain 3 gold now.

Interest is extra gold you gain per 10g saved.

DA_SliceOfLife.name: Slice of Life
DA_SliceOfLife.text: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving 1 5-cost champion.

DA_SoloLeveling.name: Solo Leveling
DA_SoloLeveling.text: For the next 5 combats, your team size is 1, but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain 1 XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain 2 item components.

DA_AugmentedPower.name: Augmented Power
DA_AugmentedPower.text: Your next augment is one tier higher.

DA_Staffsmith.name: Staffsmith II
DA_Staffsmith.text: Gain 1 random completed item that builds from Needlessly Large Rod now and another in 1 round.

DA_Swordsmith.name: Swordsmith II
DA_Swordsmith.text: Gain 1 random completed item that builds from B.F. Sword now and another in 1 round.

DA_InfinityProtection.name: Infinity Protection
DA_InfinityProtection.text:
Gain 3 gold now. On Stage 3-7, gain an Infinity Force. Infinity Force gives allies in the same row a 12% Health shield.

Monsters Attack Championship, 2023

DA_WeStickTogether.name: We Stick Together

DA_ElectrochargeI.name: Electrocharge
DA_ElectrochargeI.text: Every 4 attacks an ally takes, they deal 25-80 (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (1 second cooldown).

DA_ElectrochargeII.name: Electrocharge II
DA_ElectrochargeII.text: Every 4 attacks an ally takes, they deal 35-120 (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (1 second cooldown).

DA_DoubleTrouble.name: Double Trouble
DA_DoubleTrouble.text: When you field exactly 2 copies of a champion, they both gain 25% Attack Damage and Ability Power and 25 Armor, and Magic Resist. When you 3-star, gain a 2-star copy.

DA_CognitiveOverload.name: Cognitive Overload
DA_CognitiveOverload.text: Gain 7 gold, 1 2-star 1-cost champion, 1 2-cost champion, 2 3-cost champions, 1 XP, and 1 Shop reroll.

DA_Dummify.name: Dummify
DA_Dummify.text: Lose all champions on your board and bench. Gain a Training Dummy with 60% of their combined health. The dummy gains 1150 Health per stage. Gain a random non-tank 2-star 2 cost champion.

DA_EarlyLearnings.name: Early Learnings
DA_EarlyLearnings.text: Your team gains 3% Attack Damage & Ability Power. This increases by 1% after each player combat. 1-cost champions gain double.

DA_KickStart.name: Kick Start
DA_KickStart.text: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion and 1 gold.

DA_BaronsLair.name: Baron's Lair
DA_BaronsLair.text:
Gain a random Tank item. After 8 seconds of combat, your team gains 4% bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

TFT Paris Open, 2025

DA_HeartOfSteel.name: Heart of Steel
DA_HeartOfSteel.text: Gain a Steadfast Heart. Every 10 seconds of combat its holder survives, Steadfast Heart gains additional 18 permanent max Health.

DA_CursedCrown.name: Cursed Crown
DA_CursedCrown.text: Gain +2 max team size, but you take double player damage when you lose a player combat.

DA_Corrosion.name: Corrosion
DA_Corrosion.text: Enemies in the first two rows lose 3 Armor and Magic Resist every 2 seconds.

DA_BoxingLessons.name: Boxing Lessons
DA_BoxingLessons.text: Your team gains 30 Health for each ally that starts combat in the front row.

DA_Ascension.name: Ascension
DA_Ascension.text: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 35% Damage Amp.

DA_NoScoutNoPivot.name: NO SCOUT NO PIVOT
DA_NoScoutNoPivot.text: Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your champions gain 1% Health, and 1% Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat.

DA_GildedSteel.name: Gilded Steel
DA_GildedSteel.text:
Gain two 5-cost champions. If you field at least one 5-cost champion, your 1 to 4-cost champions gain 8% Durability.

K.O. Coliseum Tactician's Crown, 2025

DA_Replication.name: Replication
DA_Replication.text: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next 2 rounds, gain a copy of that component.

DA_SweetTreats.name: Sweet Treats
DA_SweetTreats.text: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains 16 Health for each item equipped on champions.

DA_ComponentBuffet.name: Component Buffet
DA_ComponentBuffet.text: Whenever you would get a component, gain a component anvil instead. Gain a random component. The anvil offers 4 choices.

DA_MagicRoll.name: Magic Roll
DA_MagicRoll.text:
Roll 3 dice. Gain rewards based on their total.

{Augment.Variant.MagicRoll.Reward}

DA_SlightlyMagicRoll.name: Slightly Magic Roll
DA_SlightlyMagicRoll.text:
Roll a die. Gain rewards based on the number rolled.

{Augment.Variant.SlightlyMagicRoll.Reward}

DA_ExpectedUnexpectedness.name: Expected Unexpectedness
DA_ExpectedUnexpectedness.text: Now and at the start of the next 2 stages, roll 3 dice. Gain various rewards based on their total.

DA_FrontlineFoundation.name: Frontline Foundation
DA_FrontlineFoundation.text: Gain a 2-star 1-cost Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

DA_SpiritOfRedemption.name: Spirit Of Redemption
DA_SpiritOfRedemption.text: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every 5 seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within 1 hex for 9% of their missing Health.

DA_TheTower.name: The Tower
DA_TheTower.text: Gain a giant Training Dummy. Every 4 seconds, it zaps the 3 nearest enemies dealing 5% max Health true damage.

DA_ExclusiveCustomization.name: Exclusive Customization
DA_ExclusiveCustomization.text: Gain a Lucky Item Chest, a Magnetic Remover and 7 gold.

DA_Warpath.name: Warpath
DA_Warpath.text: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing 80 player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.

DA_DeadlierBlades.name: Deadlier Blades
DA_DeadlierBlades.text: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain 1% Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.

DA_FeelingLucky.name: Feeling Lucky
DA_FeelingLucky.text: Gain 12 gold, then flip a coin. If heads, gain 4 more gold.

DA_ComebackStory.name: Comeback Story
DA_ComebackStory.text: Your team gains 4 Health and 0.4% Attack Speed per missing player Health.

DA_CallToChaos.name: Call To Chaos
DA_CallToChaos.text: Gain a powerful and random reward.

DA_LuxurySubscription.name: Luxury Subscription
DA_LuxurySubscription.text:
Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and 5 gold.

At the start of the next 2 stages, gain the package again.

DA_ComponentQuest.name: Component Quest
DA_ComponentQuest.text: Gain a random component and 1 gold. The next 7 times you win a player combat, gain a different random component. Afterwards, gain 1 gold.

DA_NestingAnvils.name: Nesting Anvils
DA_NestingAnvils.text: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 6 gold.

DA_NestingAnvilsPlus.name: Nesting Anvils+
DA_NestingAnvilsPlus.text: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 8 gold.

DA_ChampDelivery.name: Champ Delivery
DA_ChampDelivery.text: Gain 3 2-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_ChampDeliveryPlus.name: Champ Delivery+
DA_ChampDeliveryPlus.text: Gain 3 3-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_ChampDeliveryPlusPlus.name: Champ Delivery++
DA_ChampDeliveryPlusPlus.text: Gain 3 4-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_VerticalityI.name: Verticality
DA_VerticalityI.text: Champions gain 1.5% Attack Damage, 1.5% Ability Power, [resists?] Armor, and [resists?] Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_VerticalityII.name: Verticality II
DA_VerticalityII.text: Champions gain 2.5% Attack Damage, 2.5% Ability Power, [resists?] Armor, and [resists?] Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_VerticalityIII.name: Verticality III
DA_VerticalityIII.text: Champions gain 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, [resists?] Armor, and [resists?] Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_CapitalGainsI.name: Capital Gains
DA_CapitalGainsI.text: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 100% of the stored gold. Gain 1 gold now.

DA_CapitalGainsII.name: Capital Gains II
DA_CapitalGainsII.text: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 125% of the stored gold. Gain 3 gold now.

DA_FutureFocused.name: Future Focused
DA_FutureFocused.text: Your Tactician loses 20 Health, but after 5 player combats, gain 3 4-cost champions and 5 gold.

DA_QuickStreaks.name: Quick Streaks
DA_QuickStreaks.text: You gain twice as much progress towards win and loss streaks. Gain 2 gold.

DA_ClutteredMind.name: Cluttered Mind
DA_ClutteredMind.text: Gain 4 1-cost champions now. If your bench is full at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

DA_BirthdayPresent.name: Birthday Present
DA_BirthdayPresent.text: Gain a 2-star champion and 1 gold each time you level up. The champion's cost tier is your level minus 4 (max: 5-cost).

DA_GoldenGamble.name: Golden Gamble
DA_GoldenGamble.text: Gain 2 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_GoldenGamblePlus.name: Golden Gamble+
DA_GoldenGamblePlus.text: Gain 3 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_GoldenGamblePlusPlus.name: Golden Gamble++
DA_GoldenGamblePlusPlus.text: Gain 6 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_UrfsGrabBag.name: Urf's Grab Bag
DA_UrfsGrabBag.text: Gain 1 Spatula, 3 random components, and 5 gold.

DA_URF.name: U.R.F
DA_URF.text: Gain a Spatula. Spatula or Frying Pan items gain 20% Attack Speed and 3 Mana Regen.

DA_PartialAscension.name: Partial Ascension
DA_PartialAscension.text: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 20% Damage Amp.

DA_Expedition.name: Expedition
DA_Expedition.text: At the start of every round, lose the champion in the rightmost bench slot. After losing 33 gold of champions in this way, gain a powerful reward. Gain a 3-cost champion now.

DA_TonsOfStatsI.name: Tons of Stats!
DA_TonsOfStatsI.text: Your team gains 44 Health, 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 4 Armor, 4 Magic Resist, 4% Attack Speed, and 4 Mana.

DA_TonsOfStatsII.name: TONS of Stats!
DA_TonsOfStatsII.text: Your team gains 88 Health, 8% Attack Damage, 8% Ability Power, 8 Armor, 8 Magic Resist, 8% Attack Speed, and 8 Mana.

DA_BoosterPack.name: Booster Pack
DA_BoosterPack.text: Gain 12 gold of random champions. (At least one 3-cost guaranteed!)

DA_BoosterPackPlus.name: Booster Pack+
DA_BoosterPackPlus.text: Gain 18 gold of random champions. (At least one 4-cost guaranteed!)

DA_BoosterPackPlusPlus.name: Booster Pack++
DA_BoosterPackPlusPlus.text: Gain 26 gold of random champions. (At least one 5-cost guaranteed!)

DA_CyberneticUplink_Gold.name: Cybernetic Uplink
DA_CyberneticUplink_Gold.text: Your champions holding an item gain 100 Health and 2 Mana Regen. Gain a Tear of the Goddess.

DA_CyberneticImplants_Gold.name: Cybernetic Implants
DA_CyberneticImplants_Gold.text: Your champions holding an item gain [HPFromGold?] Health and 15% Attack Damage. Gain a B.F. Sword.

DA_PlotArmor.name: Plot Armor
DA_PlotArmor.text: Your team gains 10 Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below 0.5 Health, increase this to 40 for the rest of combat.

DA_ItsMeBaby.name: It's Me, Baby
DA_ItsMeBaby.text:
Gain a championship hex in the bottom right corner. The champion in it gains 15% Damage Amp and 15% Attack Speed, and drops 1 gold every 5 takedowns.

Lore & Legends Tactician's Crown, 2026

DA_DeadlierCaps.name: Deadlier Caps
DA_DeadlierCaps.text: Gain a Rabadon's Deathcap. Rabadon's Deathcaps grant 1 Mana Regen and permanently gain 1% Ability Power whenever their holders score a takedown.

DA_GoldDestiny.name: Gold Destiny
DA_GoldDestiny.text: Gain a random Gold Augment and 3 gold.

DA_GoldDestinyPlus.name: Gold Destiny+
DA_GoldDestinyPlus.text: Gain a random Gold Augment and 5 gold.

DA_SilverDestiny.name: Silver Destiny
DA_SilverDestiny.text: Gain a random Silver Augment and 2 gold.

DA_SilverDestinyPlus.name: Silver Destiny+
DA_SilverDestinyPlus.text: Gain a random Silver Augment and 4 gold.

DA_SilverDestinyPlusPlus.name: Silver Destiny++
DA_SilverDestinyPlusPlus.text: Gain a random Silver Augment and 7 gold.

DA_PrismaticDestiny.name: Prismatic Destiny
DA_PrismaticDestiny.text: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and [Gold ?] gold.

DA_PrismaticDestinyPlus.name: Prismatic Destiny+
DA_PrismaticDestinyPlus.text: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 7 gold.

DA_MissedConnections.name: Missed Connections
DA_MissedConnections.text: Gain a copy of each 1-cost champion.

DA_Swiftstriker19_DeathByAThousandCuts.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
DA_Swiftstriker19_DeathByAThousandCuts.text: After 250 and 1000 Swiftstriker attacks, gain a Completed Item Anvil and 12 Gold. Gain a Ziggs and a Yunara.

DA_Choreographer19_DanceParty.name: Dance Party
DA_Choreographer19_DanceParty.text: When you win combat, each surviving champion has a 5% chance to drop 1 gold. The chance increases by 15% for each Choreographer you're fielding. Gain 2 Choreographers.

DA_DemonVision19_Deathbringer.name: Deathbringer
DA_DemonVision19_Deathbringer.text: Every 2 takedowns by Rock champions or the Infernal Idol permanently grants him 15 Health and 2% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Gain 3 Rock champions.

DA_DemonVision19_RockAllNite.name: Rock All Nite
DA_DemonVision19_RockAllNite.text: Rock champions gain 10% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Every 2 seconds the Infernal Idol lives, they gain 1% more. Gain 3 Rock champions.

DA_Heavenscale19_TheImmortalJourney.name: The Immortal Journey
DA_Heavenscale19_TheImmortalJourney.text: Gain a Xayah, a Spear of Shojin and 3 gold.

DA_ConstructACompanion.name: Construct a Companion
DA_ConstructACompanion.text: The next 1-cost champion you buy is 3-star. Gain 2 gold.

DA_SpreadingRoots.name: Spreading Roots
DA_SpreadingRoots.text: Gain a random Emblems. After 3 combats, gain another.

DA_TheTraitTreePlus.name: The Trait Tree+
DA_TheTraitTreePlus.text: Gain 3 random Emblems, a Reforger, and 4 gold.

DA_TimeSkip.name: Time Skip
DA_TimeSkip.text: Disable your Shop for the next 3 rounds. Then gain 32 XP.

DA_TraitLadder.name: Trait Ladder
DA_TraitLadder.text: Gain a random emblem. After fielding 2 non-unique traits in a player combat, gain a reward. Then increase the number of traits needed and the size of the reward.

DA_PandorasBench.name: Pandora's Bench
DA_PandorasBench.text: At the start of every round, champions on the 3 rightmost bench slots transform into random champions of the same cost. Gain 1 gold.

DA_Recombobulator.name: Recombobulator
DA_Recombobulator.text: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Gain 2 Magnetic Removers and 3 free rerolls.

DA_19_KDACrown.text: Gain a K/DA Emblem, a Guinsoo's Rageblade, and a Kai'Sa.

DA_19_ManagerCirclet.text: Gain a Manager Emblem, a Chain Vest, and a Leona.

DA_19_PentakillCrown.text: Gain a Pentakill Emblem, a Giant Slayer, and a Viego.

DA_19_SwiftstrikerCrown.text: Gain a Swiftstriker Emblem, a Hextech Gunblade, and a Bard.

DA_19_TrueDamageCrown.text: Gain a True Damage Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Senna.

DA_19_VirtuososCrown.name: Classical Crown
DA_19_VirtuososCrown.text: Gain a Classical Emblem, a Spirit Visage, and a Nasus.

DA_TrueDamage19_PainIntoPassion.name: Pain into Passion
DA_TrueDamage19_PainIntoPassion.text:
On the A-Side, True Damage champions gain 1% Attack Speed and 10 Health for every 20 Bling collected. On the B-Side, gain 3 Gold after losing combat. 

Gain 3 True Damage champions.

DA_19_ArcanistCirclet.name: Arcanist Circlet
DA_19_ArcanistCirclet.text: Gain an Arcanist Emblem, a Tear of the Goddess, and a Swain.

DA_19_ChoreographerCirclet.name: Choreographer Circlet
DA_19_ChoreographerCirclet.text: Gain a Choreographer Emblem, a Giant's Belt, and a Garen.

DA_19_DemonVisionCirclet.name: Rock Circlet
DA_19_DemonVisionCirclet.text: Gain a Rock Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and a Swain.

DA_19_HitmakerCirclet.text: Gain a Hitmaker Emblem, a B.F. Sword, and a Senna.

DA_19_IllBeatsCirclet.name: Illbeats Circlet
DA_19_IllBeatsCirclet.text: Gain an Illbeats Emblem, a Tear Of The Goddess, and a Draven.

DA_19_IonicSparkCirclet.text: Gain an Ionic Spark Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and a Briar.

DA_19_PentakillCirclet.text: Gain a Pentakill Emblem, a Negatron Cloak, and a Viego.

DA_19_RenegadeCirclet.text: Gain a Renegade Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and a 2-star Qiyana.

DA_19_VirtuososCirclet.text: Gain a Classical Emblem, a Tear of the Goddess, and a 2-star Renata.

DA_IonicSpark19_LightUpTheSky.name: Light up the Sky
DA_IonicSpark19_LightUpTheSky.text: Every 3 seconds, the 3 highest Health enemies take 0.05 max Health magic damage + 0.01 for every Ionic Spark champion you have fielded. Gain 3 Ionic Spark champions.

DA_IonicSpark19_ForeverBurningBrighter.name: Forever Burning Brighter
DA_IonicSpark19_ForeverBurningBrighter.text: Your Ionic Spark champions gain 8% Attack Damage and Ability Power, increased permanently by 1% for every 30 gifts given by fans. Gain 3 Ionic Spark champions.

DA_IonicSpark19_OurHeartsAligned.name: Our Hearts Aligned
DA_IonicSpark19_OurHeartsAligned.text: Every time Ionic Spark champions collectively spend 600 Mana, they all gain a 0.1 max Health Shield for 6 seconds. Gain 3 Ionic Spark champions.

DA_Glitterbomb19_RerollExe.name: reroll.exe
DA_Glitterbomb19_RerollExe.text: At the start of every stage, including this one, gain 2 free rerolls, plus 1 for every 250 Hyperpop Hype you have. Gain a 2-star Ziggs.

DA_MadScience.name: Mad Science
DA_MadScience.text:
Each ally randomly becomes huge or tiny.

Huge units gain 12% max Health and 20% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Tiny units gain 0.89 Durability and 20% Attack Speed

DA_19_AimHigh.name: Aim High
DA_19_AimHigh.text: The first 2 times you purchase a unique unlockable 5-cost champion, gain a recommended item for them.

DA_19_RareCollection.name: Rare Collection
DA_19_RareCollection.text: Your team gains 50 Health and 3% Attack Speed per unique unlockable champion fielded.

DA_CritQuintessence.name: Crit Rune
DA_CritQuintessence.text: Gain 8 gold. Your team gains 1% Critical Strike Chance.

DA_19_PyramidScheme.name: Pyramid Scheme
DA_19_PyramidScheme.text:
After fighting a player who isn't in the Pyramid Scheme, steal 3 gold from them and give them a weaker copy of this augment. 

Round Start: Gain 1 gold per player in the Scheme, or 10 gold if all players are in the Scheme

DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level2.name: Pyramid Scheme, Level 2
DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level2.text: Combat start: If your opponent isn't already in the Pyramid Scheme, steal 2 gold from them and give them a weaker copy of this augment.

DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level3.name: Pyramid Scheme, Level 3
DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level3.text: Combat start: If your opponent isn't already in the Pyramid Scheme, steal 1 gold from them and give them a weaker copy of this augment.

DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level4.name: Pyramid Scheme, Level 4
DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level4.text: Combat start: If your opponent isn't already in the Pyramid Scheme, steal 1 gold from them and give them a weaker copy of this augment.

DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level5.name: Pyramid Scheme, Level 5
DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level5.text: Combat start: If your opponent isn't already in the Pyramid Scheme, steal 1 gold from them and give them a weaker copy of this augment.

DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level6.name: Pyramid Scheme, Level 6
DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level6.text: Combat start: If your opponent isn't already in the Pyramid Scheme, steal 1 gold from them and give them a weaker copy of this augment.

DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level7.name: Pyramid Scheme, Level 7

DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level8.name: Pyramid Scheme, Level 8
DA_19_PyramidScheme_Level8.text: Combat start: If your opponent isn't already in the Pyramid Scheme, steal 1 gold from them and give them a weaker copy of this augment.

DA_DuplicatorDeal.name: Duplicator Deal
DA_DuplicatorDeal.text: Gain 3 Champion Duplicators. You can no longer 3-star champions.

DA_BeltSmith1.name: Beltsmith
DA_BeltSmith1.text: Gain 1 random completed item that builds from Giant's Belt.

DA_BeltSmith2.name: Beltsmith II
DA_BeltSmith2.text: Gain 1 random completed item that builds from Giant's Belt now and another in 1 round.

DA_SwordSmith1.name: Swordsmith
DA_SwordSmith1.text: Gain 1 random completed item that builds from B.F. Sword.

DA_StaffSmith1.name: Staffsmith
DA_StaffSmith1.text: Gain 1 random completed item that builds from Needlessly Large Rod.

DA_19_HeartsteelPrismaticTour.name: Heartsteel Prismatic Tour
DA_19_HeartsteelPrismaticTour.text:
Gain the Heartsteel Prismatic Quest, 3 Heartsteel champions, a Lucky Item Chest, and 7 gold.

Have Heartsteel allies deal damage, block damage, and heal health with 7 Heartsteel active!

DA_19_HeartsteelPrismaticTourPlus.name: Heartsteel Prismatic Tour+
DA_19_HeartsteelPrismaticTourPlus.text:
Gain the Heartsteel Prismatic Quest, 3 Heartsteel champions, 3 components, and 2 gold.

Have Heartsteel allies deal damage, block damage, and heal health with 7 Heartsteel active!

DA_19_IonicSparkPrismaticTour.name: Ionic Spark Prismatic Tour
DA_19_IonicSparkPrismaticTour.text:
Gain the Ionic Spark Prismatic Quest, 3 Ionic Spark champions, a Lucky Item Chest, and 7 gold.

With 7 Ionic Spark active, collect album signatures over 10 rounds, then field 10 Ionic Spark!

DA_19_IonicSparkPrismaticTourPlus.name: Ionic Spark Prismatic Tour+
DA_19_IonicSparkPrismaticTourPlus.text:
Gain the Ionic Spark Prismatic Quest, 3 Ionic Spark champions, 2 components, and 10 gold.

With 7 Ionic Spark active, collect album signatures over 10 rounds, then field 10 Ionic Spark!

DA_19_KDAPrismaticTour.name: K/DA Prismatic Tour
DA_19_KDAPrismaticTour.text:
Gain the K/DA Prismatic Quest, 3 K/DA champions, 2 Tiny Duplicators, a Lesser Champion Duplicator, and 10 gold.

Reach 21 star levels of K/DA champions!

DA_19_KDAPrismaticTourPlus.name: K/DA Prismatic Tour+
DA_19_KDAPrismaticTourPlus.text:
Gain the K/DA Prismatic Quest, 3 K/DA champions, 2 Tiny Duplicators, 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators, and 6 free rerolls.

Reach 21 star levels of K/DA champions!

DA_19_PentakillPrismaticTour.name: Pentakill Prismatic Tour
DA_19_PentakillPrismaticTour.text:
Gain the Pentakill Prismatic Quest, 3 Pentakill champions, a Lucky Item Chest, and 7 gold.

Reach level 10 and have a Pentakill ally score multikills with 7 Pentakill active!

DA_19_PentakillPrismaticTourPlus.name: Pentakill Prismatic Tour+
DA_19_PentakillPrismaticTourPlus.text:
Gain the Pentakill Prismatic Quest, 3 Pentakill champions, 2 components, and 10 gold.

Reach level 10 and have a Pentakill ally score multikills with 7 Pentakill active!

DA_19_TrueDamagePrismaticTour.name: True Damage Prismatic Tour
DA_19_TrueDamagePrismaticTour.text:
Gain the True Damage Prismatic Quest, 3 True Damage champions, 3 components, and 2 gold.

Hit the right sequence of wins and losses with 5 True Damage active!

DA_Cloning.name: Cloning
DA_Cloning.text:
After each player combat, gain a copy of a random champion on your board.

If you have fewer than 3 unique champions, you may instead instead gain gold

DA_BlindBox.name: Blind Box
DA_BlindBox.text: Gain a random Gold Augment, but lose 5 gold.

DA_BlindBoxPlus.name: Blind Box
DA_BlindBoxPlus.text: Gain a random Gold Augment, but lose 8 gold.

DA_BlindBoxPlusPlus.name: Blind Box
DA_BlindBoxPlusPlus.text: Gain a random Gold Augment, but lose 11 gold.

DA_PandorasBox.name: Pandora's Box
DA_PandorasBox.text: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Then reforge all of your items, gain a random gold augment, and gain a random completed item.

DA_BlindBoxII.name: Blind Box II
DA_BlindBoxII.text: Gain a random Prismatic Augment, but lose 8 gold.

DA_BlindBoxIIPlus.name: Blind Box II
DA_BlindBoxIIPlus.text: Gain a random Prismatic Augment, but lose 12 gold.

DA_StatsOnStats.name: Stats On Stats
DA_StatsOnStats.text: Now and after every 5 rounds, gain 3 stat boosting consumables.

DA_StatsOnStatsII.name: Stats On Stats II
DA_StatsOnStatsII.text: Now and after every 5 rounds, gain 4 stat boosting consumables.

DA_ArmorStand.name: Armor Stand
DA_ArmorStand.text: Gain a Training Dummy with a Thief's Gloves. It always rolls Tank items.

DA_KeepingTempo.name: Keeping Tempo
DA_KeepingTempo.text: After winning player combat, gain a free Shop reroll.

DA_BoosterBox.name: Booster Box
DA_BoosterBox.text: Now and at the start of the next 2 stages, gain a pack of champions. (At least one holographic guaranteed!)

DA_Augment19_Heartsteel_SmallSquad.name: Small Squad
DA_Augment19_Heartsteel_SmallSquad.text: When you field 3 or fewer Heartsteel champions, increase their bonuses by 100%. Gain 2 Heartsteel champions.

DA_Olaf19_HeroAugment.name: Axe Crescendo
DA_Olaf19_HeroAugment.text: Gain an Olaf. Your strongest Olaf becomes a ranged Attack Marksman with a single target Ability that gets stronger with each cast.

DA_Sett19_HeroAugment.name: Punch Line
DA_Sett19_HeroAugment.text: Gain a Sett. Your strongest Sett becomes an Attack Fighter with a punch that can execute enemies, making them fly away.

DA_ChampionAirdrop.name: Champion Airdrop
DA_ChampionAirdrop.text: Gain 3 2-cost champions now and 3 more after 5 rounds. After each airdrop, increase the round delay and the number of champions by 1.

DA_ZekesHeraldAugment.name: Zeke's Herald
DA_ZekesHeraldAugment.text: Gain a Zeke's Herald, an item which grants 30% Attack Speed to the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row.

DA_RanduinsOmenAugment.name: Randuin's Omen
DA_RanduinsOmenAugment.text: Gain a Randuin's Omen, an item which grants 30 Armor and Magic Resist to the holder and allies within 1 hex.

DA_ChaliceOfPowerAugment.name: Chalice of Power
DA_ChaliceOfPowerAugment.text: Gain a Chalice of Power, an item which grants 25% Ability Power and 1 Mana Regen to the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row.

DA_Pinata.name: Piñata
DA_Pinata.text: Gain a Training Dummy with 3 Giant's Belts. Your training dummies drop 1 gold for every 700 damage they take.

DA_Augment19_Manager_StakeholderMeeting.name: Stakeholder Management
DA_Augment19_Manager_StakeholderMeeting.text: Gain 2 additional Manager hexes. Managers placed in Manager hexes gain 10% max Health and an additional 50% of hex bonuses. In 4 rounds gain a Leona and 2 Prodigy champions.

DA_Augment19_Manager_StakeholderMeetingL.name: Stakeholder Management+
DA_Augment19_Manager_StakeholderMeetingL.text: Gain 2 additional Manager hexes. Managers placed in Manager hexes gain 10% max Health and an additional 50% of hex bonuses. Gain a Leona and 2 Prodigy champions.

DA_Augment19_Manager_ManagementTrack.name: Management Track
DA_Augment19_Manager_ManagementTrack.text:
Gain a Manager Emblem and a Leona. When champions gain bonuses from Manager there is a 60% chance to gain 1 gold. 

After collecting 20 gold from the Manager trait, gain a Dr. Mundo and a Warmog's Armor.

DA_Lillia19_HeroAugment.name: Dancin' n' Prancin'
DA_Lillia19_HeroAugment.text: Gain a Lillia. Your strongest Lillia becomes a Magic Fighter that prances around the board and deals stacking magic damage over time.

DA_Oceansong19_EconAugment.name: Unearthed Treasure
DA_Oceansong19_EconAugment.text: After player combat, each unique Beach Pop champion empowered by a Beach Pop instrument has a chance to uncover some loot! Gain a Taric, a Zoe, and a Renekton.

DA_Classical19_CombatAugment.name: Immortalized in Theater
DA_Classical19_CombatAugment.text: The first 3 allies to die each combat become statues. When the statues die, they Captivate adjacent enemies for 4 seconds. Gain a Katarina and a Renata Glasc.

DA_SubmitToThePit.name: Submit to the Pit
DA_SubmitToThePit.text: Allies gain 3% Attack Damage and Ability Power for every second they're in the center 4 rows of the battlefield.

DA_ThreeFourTime.name: 3/4 Time
DA_ThreeFourTime.text: Gain 3 gold, 3 player Health, and 3 rerolls now, and a random 3-cost champion in 4 rounds.

DA_FourFourTime.name: 4/4 Time
DA_FourFourTime.text: Gain 4 gold, 4 player Health, and 4 rerolls now, and a random 4-cost champion in 4 rounds.

DA_ArmedAndGenerous.name: Armed and Generous
DA_ArmedAndGenerous.text: Gain a Hextech Gunblade. Your Gunblades' ally heal is now granted to a second target at 75% effectiveness.

DA_BattleOfTheBands.name: Battle of the Bands
DA_BattleOfTheBands.text: If you have 2 or more active Bands, your team gains 18% Attack Damage and Ability Power.

DA_WorldTour.name: World Tour
DA_WorldTour.text: After every 6 player combats, gain a completed item anvil.

DA_Royalties.name: Royalties
DA_Royalties.text: Gain a Tactician’s Crown and 2 gold. Every round for the rest of the game, gain 2 gold.

DA_ThatsThatEspresso.name: Espresso
DA_ThatsThatEspresso.text: Gain a Recurve Bow. Your team gains 10% Attack Speed. After 12 seconds of combat, increase this to 30%.

DA_StarOfTheShow.name: Star of the Show
DA_StarOfTheShow.text: Gain a 2-star 1-cost non-Tank champion and an Emblem for one of their traits. On Stage 3-1, gain 6 more copies of that champion.

DA_StrangeDuet.name: Strange Duet
DA_StrangeDuet.text: Allies that start combat isolated in pairs gain 0.97 Durability and 5% Damage Amp.

DA_StrangeDuetII.name: Strange Duet II
DA_StrangeDuetII.text: Allies that start combat isolated in pairs gain 0.95 Durability and 8% Damage Amp.

DA_StrangeDuetIII.name: Strange Duet III
DA_StrangeDuetIII.text: Allies that start combat isolated in pairs gain 0.92 Durability and 14% Damage Amp.

DA_Renekton19_HeroAugment.name: Lifeguard on Duty
DA_Renekton19_HeroAugment.text: Gain a Renekton. Your strongest Renekton becomes an Attack Fighter who starts combat sunbathing, diving into action when an ally is in danger.

DA_Jazz19_DigOnThis.name: Dig on This
DA_Jazz19_DigOnThis.text: Your Jazz champions gain 1.5 increased Health and Damage Amp from the Jazz trait. Gain a Lucian and a Galio.

DA_KDA19_StarPower.name: Star Power
DA_KDA19_StarPower.text: When you 2-star a K/DA champion, gain a free K/DA champion. Gain a Lillia and a Neeko.

DA_KDA19_RunningWild.name: Running Wild
DA_KDA19_RunningWild.text: At Combat Start, your 2 strongest K/DA champions without 3 items get a temporary recommended item and 250 Health. Gain a Neeko and a Lillia.

DA_18_WeightTheWorth.name: Weight The Worth
DA_18_WeightTheWorth.text: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

DA_BuildABud.name: Build A Bud
DA_BuildABud.text: Gain a random 3-star 1-cost champion. Gain 9 gold.

DA_18_FOURcing.name: FOURcing
DA_18_FOURcing.text: Gain a random 4-cost champion. For each item equipped to that champion, your team gains 100 health.

DA_BonusGiftPlus.name: Bonus Gifts+
DA_BonusGiftPlus.text: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a 0.25 chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain 2 gray loot orbs.

DA_BonusGift.name: Bonus Gifts
DA_BonusGift.text: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a 0.25 chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain 1 gray loot orbs.

DA_OneTwoFive.name: One, Two, Five!
DA_OneTwoFive.text: Gain 1 random component, 2 gold, and 1 random 5-cost champion.

DA_GoodForSomethingI.name: Good For Something
DA_GoodForSomethingI.text: Champions that aren't holding items have a 40% chance to drop 1 gold on death.

DA_DuoQueue.name: Duo Queue
DA_DuoQueue.text: Gain 2 random 5-cost champions and 2 copies of a random component.

DA_CaretakersAlly.name: Caretaker's Ally
DA_CaretakersAlly.text: Gain a random 2-cost champion now. Gain the same one again every time you level up.

DA_BranchingOutPlus.name: Branching Out+
DA_BranchingOutPlus.text: Gain a random Emblem and a Reforger.

DA_AllThatShimmers+.name: All That Shimmers+
DA_AllThatShimmers+.text: Choose a gold-generating Artifact. Gain a Magnetic Remover and 4 gold.

DA_AllThatShimmers.name: All That Shimmers
DA_AllThatShimmers.text: Choose a gold-generating Artifact. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

DA_Annie19_HeroAugment.name: Tibbers! I Can't See the Stage
DA_Annie19_HeroAugment.text: Gain an Annie and unlock Tibbers. Your strongest Annie becomes a Magic Caster that leaps onto your strongest Tibbers at the start of combat.

DA_FighterFlight.name: Fighter Flight
DA_FighterFlight.text: Your Fighters and Assassins move faster and gain 10% Attack Speed. These bonuses are doubled while below 50% Health.

DA_FighterFlightII.name: Fighter Flight II
DA_FighterFlightII.text: Your Fighters and Assassins move faster and gain 18% Attack Speed. These bonuses are doubled while below 50% Health.

DA_Elise19_HeroAugment.name: Bite Marks
DA_Elise19_HeroAugment.text: Gain an Elise. Your strongest Elise becomes a Magic Assassin with a bite that she recasts on low Health enemies on kill.

DA_Renegade19_HighRolling.name: High Rolling
DA_Renegade19_HighRolling.text: Renegade kills have a chance to drop loot, scaling with Critical Strike Chance. The value of the loot given can also critically strike, granting even more loot. Gain a Qiyana.

DA_ReunionShowI.name: Reunion Show
DA_ReunionShowI.text: Gain 10g of champions that all share a trait.

DA_ReunionShowII.name: Reunion Show II
DA_ReunionShowII.text: Gain 16g of champions that all share a trait.

DA_CritQuintessencePlus.name: Crit Rune+
DA_CritQuintessencePlus.text: Gain 14 gold. Your team gains 1% Critical Strike Chance.

DA_TankApprentice.name: Tank Apprentice
DA_TankApprentice.text: Gain a Giant's Belt. After 3 player combats, gain a Negatron Cloak.

DA_FighterApprentice.name: Fighter Apprentice
DA_FighterApprentice.text: Gain Sparring Gloves. After 3 player combats, gain a Chain Vest.

DA_MarksmanApprentice.name: Marksman Apprentice
DA_MarksmanApprentice.text: Gain a Recurve Bow. After 3 player combats, gain a B.F. Sword.

DA_CasterApprentice.name: Caster Apprentice
DA_CasterApprentice.text: Gain a Tear Of The Goddess. After 3 player combats, gain a Needlessly Large Rod.

DA_CheatCode.name: Cheat Code
DA_CheatCode.text: Now and at the start of each stage, get a new cheat code. The first time you perform that exact sequence of actions, gain a reward.

DA_Kennen19_HeroAugment.name: He's Electric
DA_Kennen19_HeroAugment.text: Gain a Kennen. Your strongest Kennen becomes a Magic Assassin who permanently adds True Damage to his spell on kills.

DA_CheatCodeGold.name: Cheat Code II
DA_CheatCodeGold.text: Now and at the start of each stage, get a new cheat code. The first time you perform that exact sequence of actions, gain a reward.

DA_CheatCodePrismatic.name: Cheat Code III
DA_CheatCodePrismatic.text: Now and at the start of each stage, get a new cheat code. The first time you perform that exact sequence of actions, gain a reward.

DA_GoodFOURtune.name: Good FOURtune
DA_GoodFOURtune.text: Open a shop of 2-star 4-cost champions. You can only buy 1. Gain 16 gold.

DA_FeelingLuckyPlus.name: Feeling Lucky+
DA_FeelingLuckyPlus.text: Gain 18 gold, then flip a coin. If heads, gain 6 more gold.

DA_Omelas.name: Sacrificial Dummy
DA_Omelas.text: Gain a Training Dummy with 0.5 Durability. While it lives, all damage your champions would take is redirected to the dummy.

DA_BundleOShroomsSilver.name: Bundle o' Shrooms
DA_BundleOShroomsSilver.text:
Gain 6 mushrooms, which each grant either 1 reroll, 2 XP, or 3 Tactician Health.

Mushrooms have a small chance to be HUGE and grant double loot

DA_BundleOShroomsGold.name: Bundle o' Shrooms
DA_BundleOShroomsGold.text:
Gain 9 mushrooms, which each grant either 1 reroll, 2 XP, or 3 Tactician Health.

Mushrooms have a small chance to be HUGE and grant double loot

DA_Pentakill19_GatheringStorm.name: Gathering Storm
DA_Pentakill19_GatheringStorm.text: Your Pentakill champions gain 10 Health permanently every time the Pentakill trait executes an enemy. Gain 3 Pentakill champions.

DA_Augment19_Heartsteel_BigSolo.name: Big Solo
DA_Augment19_Heartsteel_BigSolo.text: Your Heartsteel Biases gain 150% more of all active Heartsteel bonuses. Gain 3 Heartsteel champions.

DA_TheDrop.name: The Drop
DA_TheDrop.text: After 12 seconds of combat, your team heals 20% max Health and enemies take 8% max Health true damage.

DA_TheDropGold.name: The Drop II
DA_TheDropGold.text: After 12 seconds of combat, your team heals 30% max Health and enemies take 12% max Health true damage.

DA_ThreeStepsAhead.name: Three Steps Ahead
DA_ThreeStepsAhead.text:
The next 3 times you lose a player combat, gain a 5-cost champion and 2 components.

Space Gods Tactician's Crown, 2026

DA_CountingStars.name: Counting Stars
DA_CountingStars.text: Gain 5 gold. Each time you 3-star a champion, gain 5 gold for each 3-star you have.

DA_ZZRotAugment.name: Zz'Rot Portal
DA_ZZRotAugment.text: Gain a Zz'Rot Portal, an item which summons a large Voidspawn.
